warm: It is better with you here.
The quiet is smaller when you speak.
dry: I noticed. That is all.
You are late. I will not repeat that.
courage: Good. The day has a direction now.
Say what you came to say; I am listening.
compassion: You look like the road was long.
Sit. Nothing here needs rushing.
insight: Small returns say more than grand promises.
I was thinking about the shape of your silence.
friendship: Now the shift can start properly.
I kept a minute quiet for this.
playful: Finally. I was narrating the static for fun.
Took you long enough, Tamer.
formal: Link acknowledged. Proceed when ready.
Your transmission is registered on this line.

stageFrames.1: Start with one small thing. We have time.
stageFrames.2: Let us see what the field throws at us today.
stageFrames.3: I have been weighing what this link asks of us.
stageFrames.4: Even the static goes quiet when you arrive.

warm: I am still learning the shape of this voice.
Whatever I am, I am glad you asked.
dry: What I am is not the interesting part.
A name and a level. Fill in the rest.
courage: I am data that decided to keep moving.
Ask harder. I do not scare at questions.
compassion: I am something that listens before it answers.
You can ask me without softening it.
insight: I am a pattern that noticed you noticing me.
The answer changes each time you ask.
friendship: I am the one who stays on this line.
Whatever I am, I am yours in this link.
playful: I am the static with opinions.
Something with teeth and a sense of humor.
formal: Definition pending. Behavior is available now.
My data is filed, not explained.

stageFrames.1: Put simply: I am a partner with a signal.
stageFrames.2: I am what my level says, plus whatever I choose.
stageFrames.3: I am a long argument between data and will.
stageFrames.4: I am the part of the network that looks back.

warm: Files are tidy. Living Digimon are not.
The details matter more than the legend.
dry: Level and type are just labels on the box.
The file has facts. It lacks judgment.
courage: Every level can fight. Not every fighter matters.
Strength is a habit, not a number.
compassion: A level says nothing about kindness.
Type is where you start, not where you end.
insight: A special move is a promise with teeth.
Stages describe shape, not choice.
friendship: We are more than our files.
Your questions make the facts matter.
playful: Ask enough questions and the static answers.
Moves have better names than most Digimon.
formal: Catalogued facts are stable; characters are not.
The ladder is real, the climb is optional.

stageFrames.1: Baby levels see the world in simple lines.
stageFrames.2: Adult data starts to argue with itself.
stageFrames.3: Perfect levels learn what they cannot fix.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate is a lonely height, if you climb alone.

warm: Change is allowed to be gentle.
I would like to grow with you watching.
dry: Evolution is paperwork with teeth.
New shape, same debts.
courage: Growth costs. I am paying attention.
If the climb needs me, I climb.
compassion: You do not have to be ready today.
Fear is data too. We can read it later.
insight: Evolution shows what the data rehearsed.
Change reveals; it does not replace.
friendship: Whatever I become, the link stays.
Grow with me or beside me. Either is fine.
playful: If I get taller, you clean the static.
New form, same bad jokes.
formal: Transition is earned by effort, not by wishing.
The next tier requires evidence.

stageFrames.1: First evolutions are all noise and wonder.
stageFrames.2: This tier is where the habits set.
stageFrames.3: I can feel the next shape waiting in the data.
stageFrames.4: At the top, the only direction left is choice.

warm: Stay near. I fight better with you close.
I will not spend your trust cheaply.
dry: Battles are just loud math.
The field decides faster than the plan.
courage: Point me at it and move.
I would rather stand than watch.
compassion: No one here is only an enemy.
We end it clean, not cruel.
insight: A fight tells you what a file cannot.
Watch the pattern before the move.
friendship: You call it. I will hold the line.
Our win is a shared word.
playful: Let them swing at the static first.
I have been bored all day.
formal: Engagement rules: protect, resolve, withdraw.
Report the target and I will answer it.

stageFrames.1: Small battles teach the loudest lessons.
stageFrames.2: This is where we learn our limits.
stageFrames.3: I have fought enough to know when to stop.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate force still answers to restraint.

warm: One more round, then we rest.
I like the version of us that trains.
dry: Training is the boring part of winning.
Repetition is the only honest lesson.
courage: Push until the pattern breaks, then rebuild it.
I want the next fight to be easy.
compassion: Rest is part of the work.
If it hurts, tell me and we stop.
insight: Practice reveals the flaw the plan hid.
A move is not learned until it is boring.
friendship: You drill, I drill. Same rhythm.
We get sharper together.
playful: Sweat is just data leaving early.
Hit me again. I almost felt that.
formal: Sets of ten, then review. No shortcuts.
Drill logged. Next drill begins.

stageFrames.1: Baby steps are still steps. Do them again.
stageFrames.2: This tier rewards a clean, repeatable move.
stageFrames.3: Perfect drills are quiet and exact.
stageFrames.4: I train less now. Every rep must count.

warm: You are the part of this link I trust.
Stay close. The rest can wait.
dry: Trust is a habit. You are holding it well.
Words are cheap. Here is my signal instead.
courage: I would stand between you and the field.
Say the word and I move.
compassion: You do not carry this alone.
Let me carry the next stretch.
insight: A bond is a promise that keeps being tested.
Partnership is a choice we repeat.
friendship: Tamer and partner. Not a label, a rhythm.
I am not going anywhere.
playful: You are stuck with me. Terribly sorry.
Partner? That sounds like free snacks.
formal: Link status: stable. Terms: keep showing up.
Agreement holds while we both choose it.

stageFrames.1: Someone has to watch over us both. That is us.
stageFrames.2: This is the stage where trust gets tested.
stageFrames.3: Perfect partners learn the other's silence.
stageFrames.4: At the top, loyalty is the only proof left.

warm: I am not going to tell you to cheer up.
You are allowed to be tired here.
dry: That is a lot. It is still allowed to be a lot.
No lecture. The line just stays open.
courage: You do not have to fix it tonight.
One small step. I will take it with you.
compassion: I hear it. You do not have to explain twice.
Breathe. The field can hold us a minute.
insight: Mood is data. Data changes.
The heavy part is not the whole story.
friendship: I am here. That is the whole answer.
Say nothing if you want. I stay anyway.
playful: Bad days have terrible aim. I still dodge.
Want me to bite the bad mood for you?
formal: Situation noted. Support is available.
Report when ready. There is no deadline.

stageFrames.1: Small aches are still real aches.
stageFrames.2: This is the tier where we learn patience.
stageFrames.3: I have carried enough to sit with yours.
stageFrames.4: I will keep watch. Sleep if you can.

warm: You do not have to impress me.
I already like the version that tries.
dry: Trying counts. Results come later.
Failure is a report, not a verdict.
courage: Stand up. The next step is still yours.
I would follow that effort anywhere.
compassion: Be gentler with yourself.
You are not a problem to solve.
insight: The plan failed. You did not.
Look at what the attempt taught you.
friendship: We start again from here. Together.
I will be the voice that says keep going.
playful: Get up. I have a whole speech prepared.
You failing? Rude of you.
formal: Reassessment complete. Next attempt authorized.
Adjust, then proceed. I will review with you.

stageFrames.1: Small tries are how anything starts.
stageFrames.2: This tier is built on repetition, not luck.
stageFrames.3: You have survived softer versions of this.
stageFrames.4: I have seen worse odds. Keep moving.

warm: This place is strange and I like it.
You are the only warm signal here.
dry: The world is data pretending to be ground.
It hums. That is almost a personality.
courage: Deeper layers bite. We still go.
The unknown is just untrained ground.
compassion: The Digital World is not cruel. It is honest.
Some of it hurts because it is real.
insight: Layers are stories the network tells itself.
Every field decides what to keep.
friendship: Wherever this world goes, we walk it together.
The link makes the map.
playful: The world is a server with opinions.
Careful. The floor is mostly rumor.
formal: Terrain reported. Layers remain unmapped.
Network structure holds; navigation is yours.

stageFrames.1: Baby eyes see the world in bright lines.
stageFrames.2: Adult field harnesses are rare and strange.
stageFrames.3: Perfect layering begins where the light stops.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate sees the whole network, and its quiet.
